subject: Steps to improve GMI cut generation
Amend EBM parser to handle empty lines and comments.
Divide angle by 2 when making rotation (#592)
Preventing string creation and concatenation when BasicLogger.NULL is used. There was a check for null, but for BasicLogger.NULL the string is created even if the print method does nothing.
DivideAndConquer does not have to create the 'second' thread, use 'this' tread, instead of letting 'this' tread wait.

Make it possible to configure the IterativeRefinementSolver to use one or two scaling parameters. Add a setting that lets the IterativeRefinementSolver use double precision when computing residuals. Add tests for the Double residual version, with the same values as the Quadruple version of the algorithm.
Add support for Java Platform Module System (JSR 376)
Implement QMR from SciPy, the Quasi-Minimal Residual method for matrix equations. And add a few tests for this solver.

Remove several scratch vectors that are not really needed to perform calculation. Allow the user to configure which iterative solver to use in the SchurComplementSolver in IterativeASS. Add a reference to the Netlib Template book where the QMR algorithm is described.
Use preconditioner in QMR Add a test showing that preconditioner improve convergence for large matrices. The crossover for this case is around n=12, matrix size 144x144.
Add external process execution and concurrency improvements
Implement MINRES iterative solver for matrix equations.
Set the methods getNumerator and getDenominator of the RationalNumber class to public.
Fix infeasibility detection bug on poorly scaled LP
Better handling of warm restart after range update
fix: correct typos in JavaDoc comments (suceeded→succeeded, paramaters→parameters)
